title: Exact-permutation small-dimensional RPCD verifier
objective: Independently verify the RPCD epoch operator, second-moment rate, matrix-Jensen identities and conjecture margins for deterministic small-dimensional matrices.
acceptance_checks: Enumerates every permutation for each certified case.
Records NumPy version, matrices, eigenvalues, tolerances and margins.
Tests both product and triangular-solve formulations of T_p.
